title: About page: choose the structure
question: No figures (no 100+/50+/percentages), tools instead of skill bars, no photo. Pick the composition, or re-roll.

options.label: What Happens When You Hire Me
options.lineage: the job as it actually runs, on the pad
options.thesis: About told as the working relationship: who you talk to, what the first week looks like, what you get, and what I will not do.
options.viewport: Carbon field: 'אדם אחד. לא סוכנות.' with the plain story beneath and a slip to talk. Then the four process steps as a printed schedule, the promises as ruled lines, the tools as printed labels, and a signed closing sheet.
options.risk: Least 'about me' of the three; a visitor looking for background gets working style first.

options.label: Four Rules
options.lineage: the rules printed on the back of the pad
options.thesis: The four working principles lead at full scale; the story and the tools support them.
options.viewport: Short carbon strip with the name and role, then each principle as a huge numbered rule on paper with a plain sentence beneath; the story, tools and process follow; closing slip.
options.risk: Principles read as slogans unless each one is backed by something concrete.

options.label: Story, Then Proof
options.thesis: Hero, the story in your own words, how you work, tools, then the work itself and a slip.
options.viewport: Carbon hero with name and role; a reading column for the story with margin notes (city, works in Hebrew and English, direct on WhatsApp); process steps; tools; a strip of client copies as proof; closing slip.
options.risk: Familiar shape; leans on the copy being good.
